about: Live runs of https://letterlock-app.vercel.app on Monad mainnet with a virtual passkey (scripts/live-mainnet.mjs). Each run spends one drip.

runs.diagnosis: The drip landed; the publish that followed was never included. Driving the same page with a virtual passkey and a faked eth_getBalance (nothing spent) showed viem preparing the publish with eth_fillTransaction: Monad mainnet filled maxFeePerGas 152 gwei and viem multiplied it by 1.2, so the signed publish capped its fee at 182.4 gwei, and rpc.monad.xyz answered eth_sendRawTransaction with 'Signer had insufficient balance': a sender must hold gas limit x fee cap = 70,863 x 182.4 gwei = 0.0129254112 MON, and the drip (1.5 x 70,863 x 102 gwei) sent 0.010842039. Monad testnet's RPC does not check this, so the testnet end-to-end run passed. Fix: the drip covers the publish at the wallet's bid plus 10% (0.01421795232 MON at a 100 gwei base fee). The virtual passkey of this run is gone, so its account 0xceff4e8c0d9b090b36449865320a7387f7f0332f keeps the 0.010842039 MON and can never publish or spend it.
